movers.headline: puts an **enabling fund-raising resolution of up to Rs 5,000 cr** on the agenda of its **31st AGM on 21-Sep-2026**, alongside Q1 results. Read the instrument list before reading the number: the resolution covers **equity shares, OR non-convertible debentures along with warrants, OR any other convertible securities — or any combination** — through QIP *or any other permitted mode*. So this is a **ceiling and an authorisation, not a raise**: no instrument, no price and no timing is committed, shareholders have not yet voted, and a resolution drafted this widely can be discharged entirely in debt. At ~9.9% of a Rs 50,260 cr market cap it is the largest capital-raising headroom sought on the tape today. *(The auto baseline listed this as a flat 'Rs 5,000.00 cr' fund raise, which asserts an executed equity raise that has not happened.)*
movers.quantum: up to Rs 5,000.00 cr — enabling resolution; ~9.9% of mcap

movers.headline: signs a **Memorandum of Understanding with the Government of Maharashtra** (at Mumbai, 05-Aug-2026) recording its **intent to invest approximately Rs 4,500 cr** in an integrated **Green Hydrogen** project in the state — production facilities for green hydrogen and its downstream derivatives, **green ammonia and green methanol**. The state's obligation under the MoU is facilitation only: approvals, permissions, registrations, clearances and applicable fiscal incentives. **An MoU recording intent is not a funded commitment** — there is no board-approved capex, no financing plan and no dated milestone beyond 'in a time-bound manner' in the filing. The scale is what makes it worth reading: **~1.5x Oriana's own Rs 3,058 cr market cap**, which is the ratio to hold in mind for a company that would have to fund it.

closes its **acquisition of Bluetile Games, S.L. and Bestplay Systems, S.L.** — total consideration **USD 303.02 mn (~INR 2,990 cr)** under the Amended SPA, of which **USD 89.45 mn (~INR 851.51 cr) was paid in cash as the first tranche** on 06-Aug; the balance is to be discharged as the Amended SPA provides. The targets became **wholly-owned subsidiaries of Nazara Technologies UK and step-down subsidiaries of the company with effect from 03-Aug-2026**. Nazara funded the vehicle two ways: **USD 3,38,46,807 (~INR 323.58 cr) as equity subscription** into Nazara UK and **USD 5,73,95,833 (~INR 548.70 cr) as loan**. At ~26% of a Rs 11,384 cr market cap this is the largest completed deal on the tape today — but the day's cash event is the first tranche, not the headline number, and the rupee equivalents are the filing's own, not ours.
movers.quantum: Rs 2,990.00 cr total consideration (Rs 851.51 cr first tranche paid); ~26.3% of mcap

movers.headline: receives a **Letter of Acceptance from the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC)** for the design and construction of a **desalinated water conveyance tunnel** running from the proposed water pumping station at **Manori to Charkop, extending to Mahavir Nagar (Kandivali)**, Mumbai. The company states the **Project Award Value as Rs 1,918 cr, inclusive of GST and O&M** — so the construction revenue is smaller than the headline, and part of it is a long-tail maintenance annuity rather than EPC turnover. It is Afcons' second BMC water tunnel alongside the Kasheli-Mulund conveyance tunnel, and at ~17% of a Rs 10,997 cr market cap it is **the largest genuinely new award of the day**. *(Invisible to the auto baseline: NSE carried it under subject 'Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts' but the classifier typed the row `press_release` and stored `amount_rs=0`, so a Rs 1,918 cr order could not reach movers — it surfaced only as an unquantified Business-updates line.)*

is in receipt of a **Letter of Acceptance from the Karnataka Housing Board** for the **design, engineering, procurement and construction of an International Cricket Stadium and allied development works** at Suryanagara 4th Phase KHB Layout, Indlawadi Village, Anekal Taluk, Bengaluru Urban District (EPC Mode-I). The contract cost is stated to the rupee — **Rs 990,16,12,700, excluding GST** — so the disclosed figure is clean topline, not a tax-inclusive number. At ~26% of a Rs 3,831 cr market cap, from a state housing board rather than a private developer, the execution risk sits in the schedule rather than in collection.

announces a **Mumbai expansion built on six projects signed together, carrying ~Rs 6,000 cr of Gross Development Value**. **GDV is not an order book and not revenue** — it is the gross sales potential of the projects across their whole life, before land cost, construction cost, approvals and sales risk, and it is recognised over many years as sales are booked. Held to that standard it is still the largest business-development number on the tape: **~1.7x Kolte-Patil's own Rs 3,436 cr market cap**, and a stated re-entry into the Mumbai market at scale for a developer whose base is Pune. *(The auto baseline carried this as an unquantified Business-updates line: the GDV figure sits in the press release, not the covering letter, so `amount_rs` stored 0.)*

approves **two Moradabad (Uttar Pradesh) expansions** in one disclosure. First, a new **dual-mode distillery adding ~66 mn bulk litres a year at an investment of ~Rs 293.5 cr**, to be commissioned by **Q1 FY2029** and funded by a **combination of debt and internal accruals** — the stated rationale is margin and supply security, not volume alone. Second, **bottling capacity at the same site goes from ~6 mn cases a year to ~13 mn cases**, via a new fully automated bottling unit, refurbishment of the existing molasses distillery and additional land. This is core capacity, not captive power, so it qualifies under CLAUDE.md §6 — though at ~1.7% of a Rs 17,517 cr market cap the scale is modest relative to the company. *(Recovered: the Rs 293.5 cr sits in the annexure table, so the baseline stored 0 and held the row out as a content mismatch.)*

restates, in the notes to its Q1 results, that it has **definitive agreements with Wipro Enterprises Private Limited to sell the EVA and Good Home brands and related assets for Rs 256 cr plus applicable GST**. Two things make it worth carrying despite the date: the **net book value of the assets being sold was Rs 70.48 lakh as at 30-Jun-2026**, so essentially the entire Rs 256 cr is gain on brand value, and completion is **expected by 30-Sep-2026**, with the accounting impact landing in the quarter of completion rather than this one. At ~18% of a Rs 1,404 cr market cap that is a material, near-dated cash event. **Dating it honestly: the agreements were signed on 23-Jul-2026 and board-approved that day — 06-Aug is the results-note restatement, not the announcement.** *(The baseline typed the row `jv_agreement`, flagged it as a content mismatch and held it out of movers entirely.)*

approves a proposal to raise **up to Rs 250 cr through a Qualified Institutions Placement**, or one or more private offerings or any equivalent permitted method, alongside Q1 results. This is **fresh equity and it is board-approved — but it is a proposal subject to shareholder and regulatory approval**, priced at nothing yet and with no timetable in the filing. At ~21% of a Rs 1,199 cr market cap the potential dilution is the number that matters, not the rupees.
movers.quantum: up to Rs 250.00 cr — approved, not raised; ~20.9% of mcap

movers.headline: approves raising **up to Rs 250 cr through a Qualified Institutions Placement** of equity shares and/or securities convertible into or exchangeable for equity, **subject to shareholder approval** and all other necessary consents. Same instrument and same size as Gulshan Polyols on the same tape, against a larger base — ~8% of a Rs 3,077 cr market cap. The board separately approved a **sub-division of the equity face value**, which is a liquidity measure and not capital. *(Recovered: the baseline flagged the QIP row as a content mismatch and kept it out of movers.)*
movers.quantum: up to Rs 250.00 cr — approved, not raised; ~8.1% of mcap

movers.headline: approves a **greenfield Fibre Cement Board plant at Hyderabad, Telangana** — **72,000 metric tonnes of boards a year, to be added within 24 months**, at an estimated **Rs 167 cr covering both the plant and the acquisition of a land parcel sized for future expansion**, funded by internal accruals and borrowings. At ~17% of a Rs 981 cr market cap this is the largest capacity commitment relative to size on the tape. Note the day's pattern: **Visaka Industries approved a fibre cement board expansion of its own the same day** — two producers adding capacity to the same product line in one session. *(Re-typed: the baseline carried this as an `acquisition`; the filing is a plant build, and the only thing acquired is the land under it.)*

does two material things in one board meeting, and the baseline carried only half of it. The NBFC approved the **acquisition of Saksham Gram Credit Private Limited as a wholly-owned subsidiary for a deal value of Rs 99 cr**, and in the same meeting a **preferential allotment of approximately 1.4 crore equity shares at Rs 72 per share, aggregating approximately Rs 101 cr**, subject to regulatory approvals. The two are best read together: **the raise is roughly the size of the purchase**, so this is an acquisition being funded by fresh equity at a company whose entire market cap is Rs 388 cr — each leg is ~26% of it. The stated effect is a step-change in reach, **from over 50 branches to nearly 200 across 12 states**.
movers.quantum: Rs 101.00 cr raise + Rs 99.00 cr acquisition; ~26.0% and ~25.5% of mcap

movers.headline: receives a **purchase order valued at Rs 87.53 cr, inclusive of tax**, disclosed under Regulation 30 with the counterparty detail in Annexure-A. At ~13% of a Rs 697 cr market cap it is a meaningful single order for the company. *(The baseline rounded this to 'Rs 88.00 cr'; the filing states Rs 87.53 cr, and the figure is tax-inclusive, so the revenue content is lower again.)*

business_updates: **Results season** — **225 companies** filed results or earnings-call material today; tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here. Their large rupee figures are revenue and order-book numbers, excluded as event amounts by §2.
**Swiggy** — guides to **Rs 10,000 cr adjusted EBITDA by FY31** on food-delivery affordability and Instamart; a five-year management target with no interim milestone.
**Mangalam Worldwide** — reports its **highest-ever monthly export performance** (the month is quantified, no contract is).
**Route Mobile** — launches a Salesforce-native messaging app on AgentExchange. **TVS Motor**, **Nucleus Software**, **S.J.S. Enterprises**, **Signature Global** — quarterly operational updates.
capex_core: **Visaka Industries** — approves **fibre cement board capacity expansion**, value not stated — the second such approval today after BirlaNu's Rs 167 cr Hyderabad plant.
**Parag Milk Foods** — **Rs 105 cr** capacity addition _(~3.7% of mcap)_. **KSB** — capacity addition, unvalued. **Healthcare Global** — further investment. **DCB Bank** — Rs 9.55 cr.
**Held out — not core capacity:** **Hindustan Zinc**'s Rs 13,747 cr (newsletter revenue) and **Sutlej Textiles**' Rs 20.74 cr board-outcome row, flagged as disagreeing with its subject tag.
distress_risk: **PNC Infratech** — clarifies NHAI/PIB coverage of the **Kanpur–Lucknow Expressway Package-2**: certificates issued, road inside a 15-year maintenance obligation, **rain damage on 300 m — under 0.5% of the length**, mostly repaired.
**EIH** — update on the **closure of operations of The Oberoi Grand**, Kolkata; no financial impact quantified.

**Insolvency and courts:** **Sun Granite Export** (NCLT Cuttack order), **Value Industries** (Q1 results delayed by an ongoing CIRP), **Sellwin Traders** (SAT appeal), **Reliance Communications** (its Singapore arm struck off).

**Litigation and regulatory, none quantified:** **Kaveri Seed** (hearing notice), **Mukka Proteins** (pending litigation), **Jayshree Chemicals** (award update), **New India Assurance** and **Shalimar Paints** (volume-movement letters).
equity_allotments: **Religare Enterprises** — allots **35,00,000 equity shares** on conversion; execution of an earlier raise, not new capital.
**Morepen Laboratories** — WOS **Morepen RX** allots equity to the parent: intra-group, no external capital.
**Esha Media Research** — Rs 8.96 cr allotment. **Callista Industries** — allotment on conversion.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Goodluck India** — subsidiary **Goodluck Defense and Aerospace** raises **up to ~Rs 285 cr at Rs 375 a share** from non-promoters; the capital enters the subsidiary, diluting the parent's stake in it _(~5.7% of the parent's mcap)_.
**Zodiac-JRD-MKJ** — Rights Issue Committee approves the draft Letter of Offer for a **~Rs 40 cr** rights issue — **~97% of its own market cap**, the largest proportional raise on the tape.
**Held out as debt (§3):** **Edelweiss Financial Services** — up to **Rs 1,000 cr** by public issue of NCDs; **H.G. Infra** — a combined Reg-30/51 intimation.
**Held out as reporting on money already raised:** **Lloyds Engineering** (variation of objects), **HealthCare Global** (rights-issue deviation) and **Varroc** (Reg 32/52(7) utilisation).
m_and_a: **Imagicaaworld Entertainment** — **completes** the purchase of 12,500 shares of **Mehsana Next Parks against Rs 50 cr paid**, taking the business into Gujarat _(~1.9% of mcap; cash actually paid)_.

**Chandan Healthcare** — sells its **~53.56% of Chandan Pharmacy to Chandan Hospital for Rs 16.77 cr** at an independently valued Rs 969.47 a share, paid 25/25/50% to Sep-2027 — a related-party reorganisation.

**Vedanta Aluminium (VAML)** — answers an exchange query on a Moneycontrol report of a **Rs 13,500 cr bank raise** and **neither confirms nor denies it** — a media number, not a disclosed transaction.

**No disclosed consideration:** **Bharti Airtel** (Nxtra Data capacity agreements), **Swan Defence** (scheme sanctioned), **Ekam Leasing** (NCLT second motion), **Intellect Design** (JV incorporated), **Waaree Energies** and **Oriana Power** (new subsidiaries), **Mcleod Russel** (Rs 26.16 cr restructuring).
order_wins: **GPT Infraprojects** — subsidiary **Alcon Builders** declared **L1 at Rs 72.5 cr** by CAO CON, Eastern Railway for auto-signalling at New Mugma _(~4.7% of mcap; a lowest bid, not an award)_.
**Danish Power** — order of **~Rs 37.17 cr including GST** for ester-filled inverter-duty transformers from an unnamed *"Renewable EPC Company"* _(~2.1% of mcap)_.
**Kay Cee Energy & Infra** — Substitute Performance Agreement direct with **NHAI** for RVPNL-supervised utility-shifting works, **Rs 9.06 cr including GST** _(~8.4% of mcap)_.

**Unquantified or below the §5 bar:** Powerica's 100 MW wind LoA, Refex Renewables' SECI LoA, Coal India's iron-ore block, Prime Cable (Rs 8.48 cr), Digilogic's Rs 4.88 cr MoD order, Agni Green Power's project allotment; **Railtel** Rs 37.67 cr (0.4%) and **Kajaria** Rs 64.50 cr (0.3%) dropped.
other_notable: **Le Travenues Technology (ixigo)** — an **optionally convertible loan from IXIGO PTE** into a subsidiary: neither a fresh raise nor an allotment.
**Splits and sub-divisions (never movers, §6):** **TAAL Tech**, **Interarch** and **Shankara Buildpro**; **Chavda Infra** raises authorised capital Rs 35 cr → Rs 70 cr with a bonus issue.
**Board outcomes and MOA/AOA amendments, no quantified event:** **BLS E-Services**, **Aarey Drugs**, **Jainik Power Cables**, **G R Infraprojects**, **Rollatainers**, **Rotographics**.

**Credit-rating actions — theme-only, never movers (§3); the rupee figures are facility sizes, not deals:** **IIFL Finance** (Rs 5,250 cr), **Bajel Projects** (Rs 3,500 cr, 156% of its own mcap — exactly why a facility size must not be read as an event), **JBM Auto** (Rs 2,020 cr), **Valiant Organics** (Rs 370 cr).
